PDF.js 6.5.438 (pdfjs-dist), Apache-2.0. Vendored minified legacy display library, worker, renderer, and bundled font/CMap/WASM/ICC assets. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js and https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438

Only the renderer is distributed. No AD&D source PDFs or scan images are included. Files selected in the source reader are processed in browser memory.
